name: Itch-io
description: Browse and download GB/GBC games from Itch.io's GB Studio collection.
author: Carroarmato0

changelog.v1.0.10-rc4: Implement Power Control (wakeup/poweroff), fix double d-pad input on my355.
changelog.v1.0.10-rc3: Support GIFs in cover art, enhance inventory for tracking game updates or store removal.
changelog.v1.0.10-rc2: Fix some UI issues, prevent double input on my355
changelog.v1.0.10-rc1: Add support for Arabic, Hebrew, Thai, Devanagari, Greek, and many more non-CJK fonts. Allow exiting the Pak when Cloudflare is blocking the initial fetching of the game list. Rewrite build and release to use NextUI toolchains and switch to native SDL on device.
changelog.v1.0.9: Implement basic sorting in Game List
changelog.v1.0.8: Fix the +50 owned games issue when the API returns an empty page response because there's not 51 games.
changelog.v1.0.7: Advanced logging, API key testing, game inventory, file management, purchase picker for games bought multiple times (individual and bundle), shows bundle names in picker, faster game detail scrolling. Fix coverart not shown properly.
changelog.v1.0.6: More robust handling of Cloudflare checks, download of cover art, handle game page with .zip filenames.
changelog.v1.0.5: Trasnparant gamelist caching, better scrolling in general, support asian fonts through Noto Sans JP.
changelog.v1.0.4: Add advanced logging, privacy obfuscation in logs, user agent string.
changelog.v1.0.3: Support alternative ROM Location per file-type.
changelog.v1.0.2: Place app logs in correct folder location, fix scripts and in-app version.
changelog.v1.0.0: Initial release — browse and download free and paid GB/GBC games from itch.io's GB Studio collection, with built-in content filters.
